capabilities: Convert ChatGPT LaTeX delimiters to Obsidian MathJax syntax
Handle both \(...\)/\[...\] and double-escaped \(...\) copy formats
Place display formulas on $$ lines so headings stay in the outline
Remove Markdown escaping inside formulas while preserving matrices
Run via command or left ribbon button
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires turning off the 'Auto Convert HTML' editor option, or pasting ChatGPT answers as plain text. Documentation is available in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese and Korean.
intentEvidence: This project is a fix for this project, patching the bugs that prevented it from working.
motivation: The original plugin's author had not maintained it for a long time and its bugs prevented it from working, so the author released this patched version.
problem: Pasting ChatGPT answers into Obsidian leaves \(...\) or double-escaped delimiters that Obsidian's math renderer does not recognize, so formulas display as raw text.

relations.evidence: This project is a fix for this project, patching the bugs that prevented it from working.
convert LaTeX formulas from ChatGPT's responses into Markdown formats that Obsidian can recognize

summary: Fix-fork that converts LaTeX delimiters from ChatGPT responses into MathJax formats Obsidian can render.
